admission.justification: Proved by the 28-case focused suite on the final bytes (three new repeat cases: dry absence, real completion, branch-gone completion) plus the R2 fix-verification PASS; without it the only supported recovery from an interrupted cleanup raises UnboundLocalError.

applicability: Archive-ready repeats of terminal cleanup admitted by a matching operation/arguments archive in a non-completed state.
conditions: A terminal archive is present with matching worktree_cleanup operation and arguments
The terminal state is other than cleanup-completed
kept_line is consumed only as the optional landedTips attach, which nothing else requires
exclusions: Completed-cleanup and argument-mismatch replays, which return before the branch
No-remains enclosures on the MIK-R82 rule 5 path
The first-run gate judgement, which is judged once and never re-judged on repeat
statement: On the admitted same-Attempt successor, archive-ready cleanup does not rejudge the accepted gate or invent an absent judgement record, and repeated cleanup including the branch-gone case completes with verified bound before/after evidence.
